author: Tino Mettler
name: website_gallery_export
description: Exports selected images together with generated HTML pages to build a browsable web photo gallery in a chosen output folder.
description-extensive: This export tool takes your selected photos and builds a complete web gallery you can upload to a website. You give it a title and an output folder, and it produces the images along with the web pages needed to view them in a browser. No extra software is required.
